steps.say: Warm water dissolves most solids faster than cold water. The warm water particles move faster and mix with the solid particles more quickly.
Warm water can usually dissolve more of a solid than cold water, so a hot drink can hold more sugar.
Boiling and evaporation are not the same. Evaporation happens only at the surface and at any temperature. Boiling happens throughout the liquid, at its boiling point.
A substance has a fixed melting and boiling point. Pure water melts at 0 °C and boils at 100 °C, which helps us identify substances.
Gases have properties too. They take up space and have mass. A balloon full of air weighs a little more than an empty one.
